label: Bible Study
prompt: A merry heart doeth good like a _____: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
verse: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
note: Cheerfulness as pharmacy — the KJV prescribes a merry heart.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The name of the LORD is a strong _____: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
verse: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
note: The righteous 'runneth' into it — not a stroll. It's a tower for people in a hurry.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Where thou diest, will I _____, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.
verse: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.
note: Ruth's loyalty oath to Naomi goes all the way to the grave — 'where thou diest, will I die.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: They that sow in _____ shall reap in joy.
verse: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
note: The exiles' harvest law: what you plant weeping, you carry home singing.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he _____ set his face to go to Jerusalem,
verse: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
note: The KJV spells it 'stedfastly' — no first 'a.' Jesus set his face toward Jerusalem and the cross.
